text:
maria.docs: Heads-up: I'm opening a small PR to update our rate-limits & pricing docs to the new metering header and to refresh dashboard links. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4302  :wave:
cheng: Nice. Two infra notes: (1) Grafana path changed to /d/usage-overview, panelId is 58 now. (2) alerting should switch from old metric `token_rate` to `rate_consume_by_tier`. I'll paste the panel URL after I export it.
samir: For the SDK examples we should stop recommending `X-Rate-Limit` and show the `x-rw-metering` header with `usage` and `unit`. Minimal Node snippet incoming. Also suggest a short migration FAQ blurb for customers who read the legacy examples.
olivia: Add a line about burst behavior change: "burst credits are allocated per-route and decay over ~1h (previously short per-minute bursts)." That caused confusion in support. :thinking_face:
maria.docs: Good call. Samir, can you drop a compact Node + Go + Python snippet so we can populate the 'Quick examples' box? Keep them tiny (3-4 lines).
samir: Posted drafts below — use whichever fits the docs style.
Node:
```js
// minimal: attach metering header
const res = await client.request('POST', '/v1/generate', {
  headers: { 'x-rw-metering': 'usage=120;unit=tokens' },
  json: { model: 'rw-base', input: '...' }
});
console.log(res.headers['x-rw-remaining']);
```
Python:
```py
# minimal python example
resp = client.generate(..., headers={'x-rw-metering':'usage=120;unit=tokens'})
print(resp.headers.get('x-rw-remaining'))
```
Go:
```go
// Go example for header-based metering
req.Header.Set("x-rw-metering", "usage=120;unit=tokens")
// handle resp.Header.Get("x-rw-remaining")
```
cheng: Thanks. I'll attach the updated Grafana panel JSON to the PR once exported. For the docs copy, change any references to "burst per-minute" to "per-route burst with ~1h decay" and add a note to update customer alert runbooks.
maria.docs: I'll add an explicit migration checklist at top: 1) switch examples to x-rw-metering 2) update embedded dashboard link to /d/usage-overview?panelId=58 3) change alert metric to rate_consume_by_tier 4) call out burst decay change.
docs-bot: Staging preview for PR 4302: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/rate-limits-migration?pr=4302  :rocket:
olivia: One more nit: pricing tiers bullet needs a line about request burst limits (Pro: +10 req/s burst; Enterprise: negotiated). Otherwise lgtm.
maria.docs: I'll push updates in ~20m. If CI passes and nobody objects we'll merge. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
cheng: No objections from infra. I'll confirm panel IDs after merge and ping when export is uploaded.
samir: If anyone wants me to compress the examples to single-line snippets for the quickstart box I can do that as a follow-up.
maria.docs: Great — merging after green CI.
